verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a SaaS analytics and experimentation platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never documents choosing a storage region or residency for Statsig-hosted data. Warehouse Native (analysis run in your own warehouse with no ETL) is an adjacent architecture, not a documented region or residency selection, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
